items.question: What markets do you focus on?
items.answer: We focus exclusively on Thailand, with Bangkok as our primary operating base. From Bangkok, brands can build a foundation for wider Southeast Asian expansion.

items.question: How long does a launch typically take?
items.answer: A focused market test can be set up in 4-8 weeks. A full market launch typically takes 3-6 months depending on product complexity.

items.question: Do you only work with F&B brands?
items.answer: F&B is our strongest vertical, but we work with selected brands across lifestyle, sustainability, and digital platforms.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Book a call or contact us. We'll review your brand, understand your goals, and outline how we can support your Thailand entry.

data.headline: Our Story
data.lede: NC Global Assets was founded by entrepreneurs who understood firsthand how hard it is to bring an international brand into a new market — especially one as dynamic and nuanced as Thailand.
data.body_para1: We saw brilliant brands fail not because their product was wrong, but because they tried to build everything from scratch, alone, without local knowledge or operational infrastructure. We decided to build that infrastructure ourselves.
data.body_para2: Today, our Bangkok building — with its cloud kitchen, offices and showroom — is the operational base from which we help international brands test, launch and grow across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Not as consultants. As partners with skin in the game.
